about: lantern(name, at) places one, dark (a faint ember inside); light_lantern(l) lights it: its flame, a warm light that breathes like fire, a crackle, a bell (quiet: yes leaves the bell out). Every lantern placed is in `lanterns`; lit_count() says how many are lit.
licence: our own work, free for every J Production project
name: lantern
what: a stone post with an iron cage of frosted glass, and a flame you light

about: sailing_boat(at, turn) places one and gives it back; move_boat(boat, at, turn) moves the whole boat (its hull, deck, mast, sail and lamp together), rocking gently on the water.
licence: our own work, free for every J Production project
name: sailing_boat
what: a small wooden boat with a mast, a sail and a lamp at its bow

about: lintel(a, b, height, depth, material) lays it between a and b (along x, level, at their middle height) and gives it back.
licence: our own work, free for every J Production project
name: lintel
what: a stone beam laid across from one point to another, like the top of a doorway or a ruin

about: plinth(at, height, material) stands it on the floor at `at` and gives it back; what it shows goes at at + vec(0, height, 0).
licence: our own work, free for every J Production project
name: plinth
what: a square stand with softened edges, to show something on

about: room_shell(size, floor, walls, lumens) builds it round the middle of the world: `size` is its inside width, height and depth; the doorway (2 m wide, 2.6 m high) is in the wall toward +z; it sounds like a small room.
licence: our own work, free for every J Production project
name: room_shell
what: a plain room: a floor, four walls with a doorway, a ceiling with a soft panel light
